text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi expatriates conclude fourth conference in Baghdad.
- Vice-President Taha Yassin Ramadan visits the southern province of Dhiqar (Ammarah) and urges an improvement in public services.
- A senior member of the Turkish Welfare party says the security cordon (Turkey wants to establish in northern Iraq) is an Israeli idea.
(The above stories were also carried by THAWRA)
- Iraq and Turkey agree on means of transporting to Iraq foodstuffs and medicine that will be allowed by the "oil-for- food" deal signed by Baghdad and the U.N. last May.
- PLO chairman Yasser Arafat urges the Palestinians to be ready for new confrontation with Israel.
